title: Torrent Hospitals appoints Saurabh Gupta as CEO – West
summary: Gupta, who has over 20 years of experience across KIMS Hospitals, Medanta, Fortis Healthcare, McKinsey & Company and PwC, will lead the Group’s hospital operations in the western region

contentHtml:
Gupta, who has over 20 years of experience across KIMS Hospitals, Medanta, Fortis Healthcare, McKinsey & Company and PwC, will lead the Group’s hospital operations in the western region

Torrent Hospitals has appointed Saurabh Gupta as Chief Executive Officer (West). In this role, he will lead the development and growth of Torrent Group’s hospital business and healthcare operations across the western region. Based at the organisation’s corporate office, Samanvay Gupta will lead regional business operations and contribute to the Group’s strategic priorities, hospital development and expansion plans.

Gupta has over two decades of experience across the healthcare and consulting sectors. He has held leadership positions at KIMS Hospitals, Medanta and Fortis Healthcare. He has also worked with McKinsey & Company and PwC as a Senior Consultant, where he led strategic consulting assignments in the healthcare sector.

Before joining Torrent Hospitals, Gupta served as Regional Director – Greater Mumbai at KIMS Hospitals. He was responsible for business performance, strategic planning, talent acquisition, stakeholder engagement and industry relations across Greater Mumbai and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

During his 4.5-year association with KIMS Hospitals, Gupta was involved in the commissioning and operational development of hospital units across Begumpet, Nashik and Thane. His responsibilities included hospital operations, business performance, financial management and organisational growth, with a focus on delivering projects within defined timelines.

Across his career, Gupta has worked on managing multi-hospital networks, greenfield and brownfield healthcare projects, hospital commissioning from concept to operational launch, clinical operations, and business performance and profitability.

Gupta holds an MBA in Hospital Management from the Indian Institute of Health Management Research (IIHMR), Jaipur. He has also completed a Certificate Programme in Digital Marketing and Analytics from the Indian School of Business (ISB), Hyderabad.

In his new role, Gupta will draw on his experience in healthcare strategy, hospital operations, business transformation and organisational development to help establish and strengthen Torrent Group’s hospital business. His appointment comes as the Group plans to build its hospital portfolio, develop healthcare facilities and establish a presence in the sector.
